messages:
jamie: Heads up — PR #9847 (service: routing) is blocked on a quick design sign-off. RFC attached here: https://redwood-internal/rfcs/2024-kt-traffic-split. TL;DR: introduce session-key based traffic split and a small change to shard affinity + KV cache invalidation.
nhan: Quick skim looks reasonable. Can you paste the short config diff inline so I can eyeball the safety checks?
jamie: Sure — pasted below:
```
- routing.split_strategy: round_robin
+ routing.split_strategy: session_key_hash
+ routing.session_key: "client_session_id"
+ cache.invalidate_on_split: true
```
casey: Adding arch eyes: @olga @ryan — this is on the critical path for tonight's release window. We need a sign-off (or clear reject) before 20:00 UTC to hit the deploy.
olga: Noted. High level: RFC reads ok but two asks: 1) ensure cross-tenant isolation tests exist, 2) confirm SLO/latency impact under 5% traffic. If those are addressed I can +1.
jamie: I can add a smoke e2e that verifies isolation and a quick perf run. Also added a canary plan to the PR: `canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100%` with 3h checks between steps. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/9847
ryan: If the e2e covers the isolation case and perf looks clean, I'm happy to review and approve. Ping me once CI passes.
maria: Ops note: SLO delta looks negligible at 5% canary. Recommend monitoring CPU + p99 latency for 24h after full rollout. No objection to the canary plan.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: release-2026-03-18 — tentative window 22:00 UTC. Reminder: merge freeze lifts 21:30 UTC.
jamie: Checklist update: RFC link added (above), e2e test pushed to branch (tests/isolation/test_session_split.py), canary doc updated in PR description. Requesting final arch +1 and a review from @ryan so we can merge when green. :rocket:
olga: I'll review the e2e and the perf numbers in ~45m. If green I'll approve. :thumbsup:
ryan: ACK — will do a quick pass after @olga approves. If both ok, merge after CI and before 21:30.
jamie: Thanks everyone. If anything changes I'll post updates here.
